title: build new in a project with no jitso/jitso.yaml first writes the jitso/jitso.yaml skeleton (version and comments, no list), then the draft; a second call finds the file and writes only the draft
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D7 and the templates row of the other decisions (a new build starts as a draft from a template: invalid until every empty value is filled)
intent: A new project gets the file that marks it, with every allowlist open: `jitso build new <id>` writes `jitso/jitso.yaml` with `version: 1`, comments that explain the optional restrictions and no list, says so, then writes the draft. It never overwrites the file and does not create `jitso/builds/`. A second call writes only the draft line.

wrote .jitso/drafts/first-one.yaml (tier worker, status draft): fill every empty value, check it with jitso build validate first-one, and ask the owner to run jitso build save first-one
